name: hyperspace
title: Hyperspace
description: A jump to lightspeed: stars stretch into streaks around the outgoing scene, which is pushed toward the camera, then a white flash cuts to the incoming scene while the last streaks fade. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .hsp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Sci-fi, space, gaming or tech launches that want an epic jump.
A hard, high-energy cut between two acts.
avoidWhen: Videos that already carry other flash or glitch transitions.
author: Remocn
